_comment: Player card config. Attribute = average percentile of its stats, mapped to scale_min..scale_max. Edit weights here, nowhere else.

confidence._comment: confidence = tier cap x min(1, minutes / full_confidence_minutes) x share of stats available

tier_reason.1: Aggregate stats only (API-Football): no event locations, so ratings are rough.
tier_reason.2: Full StatsBomb event data. Capped at 95%: pace, physical output and off-ball work are not in event data.
